_meta.status: PLACEHOLDER — every number in this file is an unverified ballpark. Results are not trustworthy until the entries below are checked and _meta.verification statuses are flipped.

conventions.units: All emission outputs are kg CO2e unless the key name says otherwise.
conventions.flights: No radiative forcing multiplier is applied. This understates the warming impact of flying by roughly 2x. The convention is stated in the README so the number can be argued with.
conventions.meals: 14 main meals per week (lunch + dinner). Breakfast is not modelled.
conventions.ev: transportPerKm.evKwhPerKm is energy, not emissions. The engine multiplies it by the province's grid intensity at runtime, which is why an EV ranks differently in Quebec than in Alberta.

foodPerMealKg.beefMeal.lookIn: Our World in Data — Poore & Nemecek 2018, beef herd

foodPerMealKg.chickenMeal.lookIn: Our World in Data — Poore & Nemecek 2018, poultry

foodPerMealKg.plantMeal.lookIn: Our World in Data — legumes / grains

transportPerKm.gasCar.lookIn: DEFRA GHG conversion factors — average petrol car

transportPerKm.hybridCar.lookIn: DEFRA GHG conversion factors — hybrid car

transportPerKm.evKwhPerKm.lookIn: NRCan EnerGuide / EPA combined consumption for a mid-size BEV

flightPerPassengerKm.shortHaulTripKm.lookIn: Assumption, not a measurement. Sanity-check against a real route (e.g. YYZ-YYC is ~5400 km round trip, so 1500 is conservative)

flightPerPassengerKm.longHaulTripKm.lookIn: Assumption, not a measurement. Sanity-check against a real route (e.g. YYZ-LHR is ~11200 km round trip)

homeEnergy.gasKgPerM3.lookIn: Canada National Inventory Report — stationary combustion, natural gas

homeEnergy.avgAnnualHeatingM3.lookIn: NRCan Survey of Household Energy Use — average gas-heated dwelling

homeEnergy.oilKgPerLitre.lookIn: Canada National Inventory Report — light fuel oil

homeEnergy.avgAnnualHeatingLitres.lookIn: NRCan Survey of Household Energy Use — oil-heated dwelling

homeEnergy.thermostatSetbackSavingsPct.lookIn: NRCan / US DOE guidance on 2 degree overnight setback

homeEnergy.avgAnnualHeatingKwhElectric.lookIn: NRCan Survey of Household Energy Use — electrically heated dwelling

gridGPerKwh.*.lookIn: Canada National Inventory Report electricity annex, or Canada Energy Regulator provincial generation mix. All 13 values verify from one table.
